desc: 多刀型一机搞定、结构逐点标注、铜芯动力图解、参数透明可查
name: 大功率多功能木工修边机款

shots.intent: 搜索列表里一眼看清完整机身，赢取点击并满足平台主图规范
用石台展台与灰渐变摄影棚气势承接首屏，左侧文案区一秒传递核心卖点
shots.textZone: left 40% clean vertical copy column: headline plus three small pill labels

shots.intent: 放大手工修边毛刺刮手的熟悉痛点，用同一木料的两种状态引出产品价值
shots.textZone: bottom caption strip, at least 15% of frame height, with two short labels

shots.intent: 用六张图标卡汇总购买理由，快速巩固选择动机
shots.textZone: centered headline row above the grid, one short label inside each card

shots.intent: 以十种刀路切口的木纹剖面图证明一机多用的加工能力
shots.textZone: centered headline row above the grid, one short tag under each diagram block

shots.intent: 红点引线逐点解释开关、散热、碳刷、手柄与底座，消除结构疑虑
shots.textZone: seven short annotation labels alternating left and right with thin leader lines

shots.intent: 黑底爆炸图展示铜绕组与转子结构，把动力卖点视觉化
shots.textZone: top headline row with thin slash separators

shots.intent: 高角度微距对准夹头螺母配红圈焦点，证明夹持精准与做工细节
左参数卡右整机尺寸线，一次性消除功率与尺寸的全部疑问
shots.textZone: left spec card text block plus dimension unit labels on thin extension lines at the right

shots.intent: 交替分栏的材质微距卡逐项证明机壳、手柄、底座与线材的用料
shots.textZone: text half of each stacked card: one red headline plus two or three short benefit lines

shots.intent: 低角度黑底红光收口，用一句行动号召承接下单
shots.textZone: upper-left headline block with a pill sub-label and a rounded red CTA button below

style.backgroundSystem: alternating clean panel-white #F7F7F8 infographic sections and deep charcoal #17181A dramatic sections, with grey gradient studio backdrop for hero and marble-white textured panel for selling-point grids
style.iconSystem: thin-line black icons with red #D6302E accents, red rounded pill sub-labels, red annotation dots with thin leader lines, red glowing focus rings
style.lightingSystem: neutral studio light at 5600K; bright even high-key with soft contact shadow on light panels, dramatic directional key with controlled falloff and cool rim on charcoal sections
style.lockText: consistent industrial woodworking power-tool ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of panel white #F7F7F8, deep charcoal #17181A, brushed aluminium silver #C9CCD0 and one signal-red accent #D6302E; neutral studio lighting at 5600K, bright and even on light panels, dramatic directional key with controlled falloff on charcoal sections; bold modern geometric sans-serif headlines in charcoal #2D2D2D on light panels and white on charcoal sections; consistent red rounded pill labels, thin-line black icons with red accents, red annotation dots with thin leader lines and red glowing focus rings; clean product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero angle and consistent product scale; clean balanced framing with soft contact shadow always present; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and consistent product scale; product always grounded with a soft contact shadow; annotations use small round red dots with thin leader lines that never cross the product silhouette
style.surfaceSystem: matte light-stone plinth, brushed aluminium body language, clear acrylic base, raw and finished light wood workpieces
style.typography: bold modern geometric sans-serif headlines; charcoal #2D2D2D on light panels, white on charcoal sections
